selection.method: Farthest-profile selection over normalized structural and basic-method residual features, then individual coordinate-based editorial notes. Search nodes do not select the tier.

tierBasis: Provisional editorial grouping by residual constraint scope; search nodes are proof cost only.

lightup: For each unlit open square, list its possible lantern positions along both axes. A crossing beam is allowed, but a lantern may not see another lantern; do not confuse illuminated squares with occupied ones.

Combine wall capacity with shared illumination routes before committing a lamp. Recheck every excluded illuminator after a forced placement. Local coverage hints stall on this board, so further constraint comparison is part of its review brief.
